question: Why does a mass of fire differ in effect from a single lamp despite shared nature?
premises: A lamp and a mass of fire share the nature of fire.
Their effects are not equal in magnitude.
A mass of fire produces effects not matched by a single lamp.
inference: Shared nature does not eliminate differences in the magnitude of manifestation.
plain_english: Not in the same way by a lamp or any other single source as by a mass of fire.
